Annual Report 2024

Nordwind Industries GmbH

Fiscal year ending 31 December 2024
Prepared for the annual general meeting

Published March 2025 · Rotterdam

1. Letter to the shareholders

Dear shareholders,

2024 was a year of consolidation. Revenue grew 6.2 % to EUR 412 million, operating margin reached 11.4 %, and the order backlog stands at a record EUR 178 million. The integration of the sensor division was completed ahead of schedule, and the new production line in Rotterdam started series production in October.

1.1 Highlights

Twelve new customers in the energy sector, two framework contracts with European grid operators, and the first large-scale deployment of the telemetry platform with 40,000 connected devices.

1.2 Outlook

For 2025 the board targets revenue growth between 8 % and 11 % and an operating margin between 12 % and 13 %, supported by the ramp of the second production line and the expansion of the service business.

2. Financial statements (summary)

The full financial statements are available on the investor relations site. The summary below shows the key figures in EUR millions: revenue 412, EBITDA 89, net income 47, equity ratio 38 %, net debt to EBITDA 1.1.
